body: Adds `tasks/paddle-ball-bounce`: one arm holds a real table-tennis bat while the other drops a 40 mm ball onto it, then the bat must keep the ball bouncing 10 times in a row, each bounce rising above a red line, with every hit timed to add energy. Category: Societal relatability. Dream-1 run: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0.
